# Mindmaker

> Krish Raja's commercial decision practice.

Mindmaker helps founders, CEOs, CROs and strategy leaders resolve hard product, price, go-to-market and company decisions as AI changes the market.

## The Sprint

- [The Sprint](/sprint): one decision over 21 days.
- Krish researches, challenges, models, coordinates and makes the call with the client.
- The client gives decisions and introductions. There is no homework.
- The work ends with the decision made, the reason kept and the first material action under way.
- Price is set on the fit call and is not published.

## CTRL by Mindmaker

CTRL is the private workspace left with the client. It holds the business context, decision, evidence and reasoning. It is the deliverable, not a separate purchase on this site.

## Proof

- [Client results](/case-studies): eight verified, anonymous stories organised by the decision and result.
- Mindmaker has helped over 4000 leaders with what is next in AI.
- Organisation logos on the site are attendance proof, not client claims.

## How Krish works

- [How I operate](/operator): evidence from the systems Krish builds and runs himself.
- More than 17 years across data, technology and product strategy, plus two years working deep inside AI.

## Mindmaker Live

- [Mindmaker Live](https://live.themindmaker.ai): the publication.
- Paid follows where the money is moving. Built shows how operators respond. These are article types, not payment plans.
